name: Lambda-class T-4a shuttle
description: The Lambda-class T-4a shuttle, also known as the Imperial Shuttle, was a standard light utility craft in common with the Imperial military as a transport for troops and high-ranking individuals.

data.name: Lambda-class T-4a shuttle
manufacturer: Sienar Fleet Systems (designer and primary builder)
data.engine: SFS-204 sublight ion engines (2) or Z-Rk5 ion engines (2)
data.armament:
Standard configuration:
2 x Steerable forward twin Taim & Bak KX5 laser cannons 

2 x Taim & Bak GA-60s twin laser cannons 

1 x Aft retractable ArMek R-T0 twin blaster cannon 

Alternate military configuration:
Taim & Bak KX5 laser cannons (8 or 4 x 2 forward, 2 or 1 x 2 aft)
data.escapepods: Detachable cockpit serves as escape pod
data.cargohandling: Personnel tractor beam (equipped when used as a rescue craft)
data.communications: HoloNet transceiver (in some Imperial VIP models)
